description_en: Queries the backup usage for a MongoDB replica set or sharded cluster instance that uses cloud disks
description_zh: 查询MongoDB云盘版副本集或分片集群的备份使用量
kebab_example: aliyun dds describe-backup-storage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id dds-2zeb2d64cb46xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupStorage

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance is located. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html进行查询
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is required if the DBInstanceId parameter specifies the ID of a sharded cluster instance
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数为必填
parameters.name: node_id

FreeSize.description_en: The free backup quota for the instance. Unit: bytes
FreeSize.description_zh: 实例免费备份数据额度，单位为字节（B）

FullStorageSize.description_en:
The storage space used by full backups. Unit: bytes.

Instances that use cloud disks are backed up using snapshots. The size of a full backup is the total size of the snapshot chain
FullStorageSize.description_zh:
实例全量备份数据内置存储量，单位为字节（B）。
云盘版实例使用快照备份，当前全量的备份的大小为快照链的大小

LogStorageSize.description_en: The storage space used by log backups. Unit: bytes
LogStorageSize.description_zh: 实例日志备份数据内置存储量，单位为字节（B）
